name: marketing-hub-lite-scripts
description: Renders the approved tile templates to PNG at platform sizes.

scripts.samples: node render-tile.mjs listing-tile ../templates/samples/listing-tile.json --formats square,portrait,story,landscape,gbp --out ../out/samples && node render-tile.mjs pm-hero ../templates/samples/pm-hero.json --formats square,portrait,story,landscape,gbp --out ../out/samples && node render-tile.mjs quote-card ../templates/samples/quote-card.json --formats square,portrait,story,landscape --out ../out/samples && node render-tile.mjs me2-post ../templates/samples/me2-post.json --formats square,portrait,story,landscape --out ../out/samples
